QuestInfo.name: Cassandra's Spring Flower Festival
QuestInfo.0: Spring blooms in Maple World.You hear that Cassandra is holding a Spring Flower Festival. Let's go talk to her.
QuestInfo.1: Let's go ahead and help out Cassandra with her request.
QuestInfo.2: You helped Cassandra plant the spring flowers and bring them to full bloom, and you received one in return. Apparently this will be enough to stimulate the various research taking place in Maple World regarding these spring flowers.
QuestInfo.summary: Let's give Cassanda 10 Spring Flower Petals and 10 Glistening Sunlight.

0.0: Can you hear that spring is coming?

yes.0: I love warm weather! Please collect 10 Spring Flower Petals around Maple World. I want to plant an azalea, a forsythia, and a clover that bloom in the spring.
yes.1: Every flower has its own floral language. Isn't that sweet? I can let you know your flower's language once you give it to me. So please bring #b10 Spring Flower Petals and 10 Glistening Sunlights#k to plant a spring flower!

no.0: Don't you know that spring is coming to Maple World?

1.0: Wow! You finally collected all of the petals! Thank you. We can plant spring flowers.

yes.0: Hey, look! The flowers are in full bloom!  The floral language for Azaleas is Love, Forsythias mean Hope, and Clovers mean Luck. I will cast a spell on you just like the floral language for these flowers.\r\n

item.0: Not enough! I told you that you have to collect #b10 Spring Flower Petals and 10 Glistening Sunlights#k.
